assumptions.description: Transport the SHIP-Trend sex-specific conditional age associations and marginal distribution anchors from northeastern Germany to the supplied PNS participants. This is unvalidated; assays, ancestry, selection, calendar time and clinical composition may differ.

Use the SHIP-Trend marginal sex-specific medians as conditional locations at age 49.5 years and BMI 27 kg/m2. These reference covariates and conversion from marginal to conditional location are assumptions; the replay can diagnose the induced marginal mismatch.

The contemporaneous BMI coefficient is assumed to be +0.02 HbA1c percentage points per kg/m2, identical by sex and linear. Its value and sign are not inferred from Hoorn adjusted-for-glucose or DIRECT prospective coefficients. It is not established by the admitted evidence.

Use a shifted lognormal residual: scale 0.95 times (exp(0.5 Z)-1), Z standard normal. Median residual zero, individual variation right-skewed. Scale/shape are assumptions motivated by approximately 0.8 percentage-point whole-cohort IQR, not a fitted source residual distribution. No separate diabetes component is identified.

Add age and BMI effects to the sex-specific location, with sex-specific linear age slopes across 20-79. No unreported spline term is used. The conditional residual distribution is constant across age, sex and BMI. Unmodeled interactions/nonlinearities are unassessed, not empirically absent.

Source replay is an artificial balanced covariate lattice: every integer age 20-79, BMI values 19,21,23,25,27,29,31,33,35, both sexes, ten repetitions. Age and BMI are independent and sex groups equally sized; this is not reconstructed SHIP microdata and does not assert the true joint distribution. Covariate support and weights are assumptions.

Identity task mapping: hba1c_pct is HbA1c in percent, age_years years, bmi_kg_m2 kg/m2, sex male/female. Published quartile convention is unreported and is approximated with linear type-7 sample quantiles. Assay and population equivalence remain unverified.

Seeds resample individual residuals only. Source coefficient SEs are retained as evidence but not sampled as independent parameter distributions. No calibrated model/transport uncertainty, causal interpretation or prediction intervals are claimed.

reference_age.derivation: Assumed midpoint of task/source-supported integer age range 20-79.

reference_bmi.derivation: Assumed centering value; not an admitted source BMI statistic.

location_by_sex.derivation: Reported marginal medians used as conditional reference locations, explicitly assumption-dependent.

age_slope_by_sex.derivation: Reported BMI-adjusted sex-specific linear age effects 0.153 and 0.191 per decade divided by 10. SHIP-Trend strata have no spline term.

bmi_slope.derivation: Explicit assumed weak positive contemporaneous BMI relationship; no prohibited coefficient transfer.

residual_scale.derivation: Assumed residual scale; 0.8 marginal IQR motivates dispersion, with covariate spread also contributing.

residual_log_sd.derivation: Assumed lognormal shape parameter, fixed across individuals and seed draws.
